2608.20768.title: Beyond Endpoint Gains: A Weight-Delta Audit of Medical Specialization
2608.20768.paper_summary: Specialist language models are usually understood through endpoint gains: the generalist scores lower, the specialist scores higher, and the difference is treated as evidence of specialization. This leaves the released update itself largely unexamined. We propose a paired weight-delta path audit and apply it to two public, aligned generalist-to-medical-specialist checkpoint pairs: Gemma-3-4B-IT to MedGemma-4B-IT and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to HuatuoGPT-o1-7B. In both pairs, the full decoder-side update strongly reconstructs measured medical benchmark movement (0.974 and 1.183 endpoint-normalized retention), making each decoder delta an appropriate substrate for the audit. Yet the movement is not cleanly localized. MLP is the strongest broad component family in both pairs, but mixed off-domain movements, 10-seed matched controls, and endpoint-anchored rollbacks prevent a unique coarse-family explanation. The audit therefore separates update-level reconstruction from component-level explanation. Its claims concern text-only multiple-choice benchmark movement, not clinical validation, repair, or circuit-level mechanism.
2608.20768.paper_summary_zh: 專業語言模型通常透過端點增益來理解：通才的分數較低，專家的分數較高，這一差異被視為專業化的證據。這使得釋放的更新本身在很大程度上未被檢視。我們提出了一種配對權重變化路徑審核，並將其應用於兩對公共的、對齊的通才到醫學專家的檢查點：Gemma-3-4B-IT到MedGemma-4B-IT和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct到HuatuoGPT-o1-7B。在這兩對中，完整的解碼器端更新強烈重建了測量的醫學基準運動（0.974和1.183的端點標準化保留），使每個解碼器變化成為審核的適當基底。然而，這一運動並未明確局部化。MLP是這兩對中最強的廣泛組件家族，但混合的非領域運動、10個種子的匹配對照以及端點錨定的回滾阻止了獨特的粗略家族解釋。因此，審核將更新級別的重建與組件級別的解釋區分開來。其主張涉及僅文本的多選基準運動，而非臨床驗證、修復或電路級機制。
